sn48.7:1.1: ye hi keci bhikkhave samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā saddhindriyaṃ nappajānanti saddhindriyasamudayaṃ nappajānanti saddhindriyanirodhaṃ nappajānanti saddhindriyanirodhagāminīpaṭipadaṃ nappajānanti
sn48.7:1.5: paññindriyaṃ nappajānanti paññindriyasamudayaṃ nappajānanti paññindriyanirodhaṃ nappajānanti paññindriyanirodhagāminīpaṭipadaṃ nappajānanti.
sn48.7:1.6: name te bhikkhave samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā samaṇesu vā samaṇasammatā brāhmaṇesu vā brāhmaṇasammatā na ca panete āyasmanto sāmaññatthaṃ vā brāhmaññatthaṃ vā diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharanti.
sn48.7:2.1: ye hi keci bhikkhave samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā saddhindriyaṃ pajānanti saddhindriyasamudayaṃ pajānanti saddhindriyanirodhaṃ pajānanti saddhindriyanirodhagāminīpaṭipadaṃ pajānanti
sn48.7:2.2: viriyindriyaṃ pajānanti viriyindriyasamudayaṃ pajānanti viriyindriyanirodhaṃ pajānanti viriyindriyanirodhagāminīpaṭipadaṃ pajānanti
sn48.7:2.5: paññindriyaṃ pajānanti paññindriyasamudayaṃ pajānanti paññindriyanirodhaṃ pajānanti paññindriyanirodhagāminīpaṭipadaṃ pajānanti.
sn48.7:2.6: te khome bhikkhave samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā samaṇesu ceva samaṇasammatā brāhmaṇesu ca brāhmaṇasammatā te ca panāyasmanto sāmaññatthaṃ ca brāhmaññatthaṃ ca diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharantīti.
